subject: Authorities executing a search warrant at a property in Mount Cotton — south-east of Brisbane — allegedly discovered 178 kilograms of cocaine and 142 kilograms of methamphetamine.
posts:

Evidence: Law enforcement action, drug seizure, organized crime disruption. #Crime #AFP

Authorities claim the successful seizure of 320kg of illicit drugs and the arrest of six men as a major victory for public safety and border integrity.
